Name: Ranger Taro - Custom NPC (outdated)
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][size=6]Hello! This mod has been updated and integrated into a larger expansion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40376?tab=description]HERE[/url]﻿![/size][size=5]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G2gYTj0.png[/img][/size]

[b]Common (and easily fixed) issues with this update:[/b]
[b]
[size=4]- on first load, the game will delete the previous, obselete version of "Suki," the traveling merchant. This will appear in SMAPI as yellow text, and will not hurt your save.

- The mod seems to be auto-set to "Warp" for Taro's Meadow. This was a fix for compatibility with various other mods that use that section of the Forest. If you prefer having the full "Path" into the meadow, change the config.json in the Map folder
(or use GMCM and find Azalea's Place and change the setting to "Path")

- [/size][/b][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]﻿ might be needed if you update mid-save, since there's an RNG chance a bush spawned in front of the "Path" meadow entrance[/b][/size]

[size=5]---[/size]

[b][size=5]A note on the two different versions of the mod:[/size]
[size=5]The difference between them is related to the traveling merchant, not Ranger Taro:[/size][/b]

[size=4]- In the Main version, the traveling merchant matches the "Suki" character as found in SVE and Portraits for Vendors

- In the Alt version, the traveling merchant matches the "Lotti" character as found in Visit Mount Vapius[/size]

[size=5]Download only one version! [/size]
[size=5]They have different folder names so there will be conflicts if you have both versions installed.[/size]
[size=4]
Thank you! Please read more below for detailed info![/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/76DHERz.png[/img]

﻿[/center][i][size=3]Ranger Taro is a character I've wanted to create for a long time. She is meant to be a lightweight experience, that adds to elements in the vanilla game and tugs at the imagination for the larger world behind Stardew Valley. Her story is about her moral dilemma, the traveling merchant, and the forest.[/size][/i]
[center][b][size=3]How to find her:[/size][/b][/center][center][/center][center][size=3]﻿Follow the fence along the north of Cindersap Forest, towards the Secret Woods. There will be a new weathered sign (and/or a path) that leads into a new location. Find her in the tent![/size][/center]

[b][size=4]She adds:[/size][/b][list]
[size=3][*]A new location deep in Cindersap Forest, 7 hearts events, 200+ lines of dialogue, and friendship rewards.
[*]Some extra details on the war between the Gotoro Empire and Ferngill Republic.
[*]New interactions with the traveling merchant.
[*]Vanilla and Nyapu-style portraits.
[*]Map configs for full compatibility with other mods.
[/size][/list]
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/9B8OR9i.png[/img]

﻿﻿﻿[/center]Ranger Taro touches on some dark themes, but nothing explicit. I aimed to make her story immersive with the storytelling in the vanilla game, which means it's also full of whimsy. She will talk a great deal about the forest and her interest in nature, and through heart events infer her moral dilemma when it comes to the natural resources of the valley. Ranger Taro is something of a philosopher and a researcher, like most park rangers.

[center]This story touches on:
cycles of violence, one's role in perpetuating violence, responsibilities one has towards their job, responsibilities one has towards their community, and responsibilities one has towards the self. [/center]
[center]
﻿Favorite Gifts:
Ranger Taro is interested in spirals in nature, although she has plenty of fiddlehead ferns to study.
[spoiler][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/a/a4/Nautilus_Shell.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/d/d2/Snail.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/1/12/Miner%27s_Treat.png[/img]﻿[img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/2/2d/Fiddlehead_Risotto.png[/img]﻿[/spoiler]

She has one particular phobia, which will be easy to figure out if you give her the wrong thing even once. She dislikes anything with this in it.
[spoiler][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/9/91/Shrimp.png[/img][/spoiler]﻿[/center]
[center]Benefits to her friendship:[/center]
[list]
[*]She sends mail at 3, 5, 7, and 9 hearts, which contain the more rare fossils that Professor Snail is looking for on Ginger Island
[*]She clears debris in the forest as she hikes around.
[*]After her 10 heart event, [spoiler]the traveling merchant will appear in Taro's meadow on Saturdays.[/spoiler]
[*]She is not romanceable, sorry :)
[/list][center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SXQMgk2.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center]
Taro arrives when you install this mod, not one day before. Meet her in her tent for the first time![/center]

[list]
[*]Mon, Tues, Thu: [spoiler]Walks to the edge of the forest near town, then circles around the lake. Studies in her meadow in the afternoon. [/spoiler]
[*]Wed, Sat: [spoiler]Heads out early to scout, hangs at the edge of town, and then heads deep into the forest near the Hat Mouse. Spends all day slowly hiking back home.[/spoiler]
[*]Fri, Sun: [spoiler]Stays inside her tent to write reports.[/spoiler]
[/list]Her schedule for Fri, Sat, and Sun change significantly after her 10-heart event. On Saturday [spoiler]she will spend time at the Saloon having a drink with the townsfolk.[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]She attends vanilla festivals, except for the Desert Festival.
[*]She can be invited to the movies and has strong opinions about them!
[*]She may be difficult to befriend, because she hikes around the forest quite a bit.
[*]Summer, 25 is her birthday.
[/list][center]

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/8OPwa6B.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Please make sure you have sound on for her heart events! Most of her events take place on Saturdays in the Forest.

[list]
[*]0-Hearts:
[/list][spoiler]Enter her tent for the first time.[/spoiler][list]
[*]2-Hearts:
[/list][spoiler]Enter the forest on a Saturday between 6am and 6pm[/spoiler]
[list]

[/list][spoiler]Enter Taro's meadow on a sunny day between 6am and 6pm[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]6-Hearts:
[/list][spoiler]Enter the forest on a sunny Saturday between 6am and 6pm[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]8-Hearts:
[/list][spoiler]Enter Taro's meadow between 6pm and midnight[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]10-Hearts:
[/list][spoiler]Enter the forest on a Saturday[/spoiler]
[list]
[*]Special Event:
[/list][spoiler]Enter the forest on a Saturday once you have 10-hearts with Taro, Linus, and Leo.[/spoiler]
